props.gloss_en: Rava bar Shmuel (in R' Chiyya's name): after all your eating eat salt, and after all your drinking drink water, and you will not be harmed
the baraita: after all your eating eat salt, and after all your drinking drink water, and you will not be harmed
the other baraita: one who ate any food and did not eat salt, drank any drink and did not drink water -- by day let him worry about bad breath
...and by night let him worry about askara
